params.body:
## What Shane saw

Staging, production data: own stock, "Wagen toevoegen", then "Wagen toevoegen via chassisnummer". After the reload the Data step had "plaatsen op stocklist" unticked and every portal of the dealer unticked. "Dat mag niet."

## What the old application did

Read in the first commit (`41173e7a`). The draft was born with `available_on_stocklist = 0` and no portals (`OwnStockController::create()`), the classic `dates.blade.php` showed the box `disabled` until on stock + technically ready + a trade price and `checked` only when the row said 1, and a portal was ticked only when the vehicle already had it. No dealer setting drives either. So the Livewire sheet reproduced the old start state; the new default is a decision by Shane (15 September 2026), recorded as a finding with `beslist: Shane` and a new rule R S2-1.18, not a repair.

## What changes for the dealer

- A new own vehicle opens with "plaatsen op stocklist" on, "op stock" on (finalizeCreate sets it anyway, R S2-1.5) and every portal the dealer subscribes to ticked. Also after the chassis lookup reloads the sheet, and on a copy (a copy is a draft too). The draft row itself stays 0 without portals, so an abandoned draft never counts as shared (insights) and never opens the detail preview to other dealers.
- The box is a wish while the gate (R S2-1.1, R S2-1.2) is closed: while adding, typing a price before ticking "klaar voor keuring" no longer clears it; `save()` writes it only when the gate passes and the sheet shows what was written afterwards. When the prices are not the reason the gate is closed, a hint next to the box says what still has to be ticked. Editing an existing vehicle keeps its stored values, and R S2-1.11 (the box goes off when a condition falls away) still applies there.
- Type "Aanbieden voor bieding" (1) and "Enkel overnamedocumenten" (2): the Data step shows only the three dates. The sections Stocklist, Showroom, Website and Portals are rendered for type 0 only, and `toBackendArray()` writes none of them for the other types (R S1-1.5). The classic sheet hid them with `own_vehicle_only` and its type JS; this pane never carried that class. The steps themselves stay the same for every type, as in the old app.
- "Wagen opgeslagen" is now visible on the sheet: `save()` and `publiceerOpStocklist()` report over the `flash` event the notify component listens on. The session flash never surfaced on the sheet (the toast partial hangs on `DOMContentLoaded`, long past in a Livewire request) and turned up on the next full page instead. The sold/unauthorized messages go the same way, in red. "Opslaan" keeps the dealer on the sheet (decision Shane, same day).

## Left as it was

- The gate itself and the classic sheet (`_tabs/dates.blade.php`) are untouched.
- The draft row still does not remember the Data step ("Volgende" writes the wired fields only), so a dealer who unticks the wish and then runs the chassis lookup sees the defaults again. Same class as every other field of that step; noted in the finding.
- `technical_ready` is not gated on the type: it also lives on the status bar in edit mode.

## Rules and tests

- R S2-1.18 (new), R S2-4.1 (portals start on for a new vehicle), R S1-1.5 (new: the Data step per type).
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-nieuwe-wagen-stocklist-en-portals-uit.md` (opgelost, ernst nu, beslist Shane).
- `VehicleFormSaveTest`: fresh draft, reload after the chassis lookup, bidding vehicle, wish behind a closed gate and applied once the gate opens, editing keeps stored state, Data step per type, nothing of the hidden sections is written. `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest`: two "no flash" assertions now check that no platform-photo message is among the flashes (the saved message rides the same event).
- Ran locally against an own database from the schema: VehicleForm, OwnStock, Portal, PlatformPhotosOnShare, VehicleSheet*, VehiclePriceWarning, CloseDealers, UnsavedChangesGuard, DamageTab, PhotoActionsDoNotReload, RulesCoverage, RulesIdentity, AlpineExpression, HandlerWiring, CompiledViews, StylesheetSyntax: OK (147 tests, 1672 assertions).

Screenshots (own vehicle, Data step of a fresh draft; type 2, Data step) in `.playwright-mcp/vin-defaults/` of the worktree: `data-step-1440.png`, `data-step-390.png`, `data-step-type2-1440.png`, `data-step-type2-390.png`.
params.title: A new vehicle starts on the stocklist and on the dealer's portals again
